threshold_provenance: Derived in a clean-room rebuild from the CLAUDE.md hierarchy alone. CLAUDE.md names no numeric threshold, and its Patterns to Follow say never to invent one -- so every value here is UNCONFIRMED and must be set by a PT before it gates anything. Do not treat these as the v4 production values.

camera_guidance.side: Both legs visible; the split stance must not self-occlude.
camera_guidance.front: Good for knee tracking, poor for depth.

rep_signal.threshold_note: down_enter_deg is the REP-DETECTION gate and must sit ABOVE the depth fault threshold (shallow_depth), or a too-shallow rep is never counted and the fault can never fire.
